title: How I built a Don't Starve-like Halloween survival game in Godot with AI help (free, playable in browser)
author: Dull_Entertainer_257
selftext: Lantern Hollow is a free cozy-spooky survival game made in Godot 4. How it was made: an AI assistant wrote and iterated all of the GDScript and built the original low-poly models in code, and the rest of the art is Kenney CC0. I came up with the ideas, played every build, and asked for each change. That's about 30 versions so far, from v1.0 to v1.8.10. What worked: fast iteration on features like a cat-hunting witch, a vampire boss and solid player-built fences. What broke: plenty! Saves not keeping builds, controller slots, and enemies firing orbs from the dark all needed fixes after playtesting. Play it free: https://rodart89.itch.io/lantern-hollow. Happy to answer questions about the workflow.
